description.html: This small round dish in dark brown has a smooth, slightly glossy surface and almost vertical walls. That shape makes it a practical feeder: mealworms and similar worms have a hard time climbing the smooth sides, so they stay in the dish until your animal eats them instead of burrowing into the substrate.

As a water dish it suits hatchlings and smaller species such as leopard geckos and fat-tailed geckos, which only need a small amount of fresh water. The smooth inside has no pores or grooves, so deposits and food leftovers come off with a single wipe of a sponge.

Place the dish on a level spot, ideally on the cooler side of the terrarium so the water warms up and evaporates more slowly. Change the water every day and wash the dish with warm water, without detergent or rinsing it off thoroughly. If you use it for insects, put in only as many as your animal eats in one meal. For larger lizards and snakes, choose a wider, heavier dish from our terrarium equipment.
